description: BitTorrent client with a built-in user-space WireGuard tunnel
notes: bittrench needs a config.toml before it will start. A config.sample.toml sits in the install directory (scoop prefix bittrench); copy it and fill in the [wireguard] section from your VPN provider.
Config is read from .\config.toml, then %USERPROFILE%\.config\bittrench\config.toml, then %ProgramData%\bittrench\config.toml.
Put yours under %USERPROFILE%\.config\bittrench\ - the install directory is versioned, so anything left there is replaced on the next update.
